title.fallback: A Clock for a New Home

summary.fallback: A newly arrived villager needs a clock for their home and asks you to gather the materials required to craft one.

intro.fallback: Hey there, are you new to this village too?

offer.fallback: Huh, an explorer you say? You must come across a lot of different resources right?
This? Nowhere. But you? You're going somewhere.

Very well, I have just recently moved into this village, thus I need some extra additions to my house. I have the usual crafting table, furnace, bed and chest sure, but I need more. That is where you come in.

Oh shush, I mean from within my own home - and don't say look out the windows. I need a clock, useful for more things than just seeing when night falls. Do you think you could make me one? I'll reward you if so.

return.fallback: Marvelous! Many thanks, stranger - this shall look wonderful on my wall. Here you go.

reward.fallback: A fine reward for a fine explorer.

done.fallback: The clock is working perfectly. I have not missed a single sunset since.
